name: fuxi-fmt-vscode
description: Format Markdown for Chinese technical writing: blank lines, marker spacing, list renumbering, CJK to Latin spacing and Chinese punctuation width - with code, front matter and inline spans never touched.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: fuxi-fmt only reads its own JSON configuration and rewrites Markdown. It executes no code from the workspace.

fuxiFmt.config.description: Explicit override, merged last. The individual fuxiFmt.* settings sit below the project fuxi-fmt.json; this sits above it, so a personal preference can beat a committed file on purpose.

enumDescriptions: Separate blocks by exactly one blank line.
Separate blocks by at least one blank line.

fuxiFmt.blankLines.maxConsecutive.markdownDescription: Cap on consecutive blank lines. `null` means unbounded, which is what makes `atLeast` meaningful (BLK-02).

fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideLists.markdownDescription: Insert a blank line between list items. **This flips a tight list to loose**, which changes how the document renders, so it is off by default (BLK-03).

fuxiFmt.typography.cjkSpacing.markdownDescription: Insert one space at every CJK to non-CJK boundary (TYPO-01).

enumDescriptions: Convert toward whichever the surrounding script uses.

fuxiFmt.typography.punctuationAllowlist.markdownDescription: Half-width marks eligible for conversion; each entry is a single character (TYPO-05).

fuxiFmt.typography.halfwidthAlphanumeric.markdownDescription: Full-width letters and digits become half-width (TYPO-06).

fuxiFmt.typography.hashtag.markdownDescription: Space a mid-text `#` from CJK. Off by default, because `#` is usually a hashtag or an anchor (TYPO-09).

enumDescriptions: By the script of the contents.
fuxiFmt.typography.parenStyle.markdownDescription: Parenthesis width, by the script of the contents (TYPO-08).

fuxiFmt.typography.semicolon.markdownDescription: Also convert `;` beside CJK. Off by default (TYPO-05).

fuxiFmt.typography.cjkClasses.markdownDescription: Which scripts count as CJK. Defaults to Han alone.

fuxiFmt.typography.symbolWhitelist.markdownDescription: Symbols that CJK spacing treats as word characters (TYPO-01).

fuxiFmt.list.orderedDelimiter.markdownDescription: Marker delimiter for ordered lists: keep it, or force `.` or `)`.

fuxiFmt.list.indentWidth.markdownDescription: Indent width for list nesting, and the width hard tabs are expanded to.

fuxiFmt.codeBlock.normalizeLength.markdownDescription: Make a fence as long as its contents require (BLK-10).

fuxiFmt.endOfLine.markdownDescription: Line ending to write. `auto` keeps whatever the file already used (BLK-11).

fuxiFmt.ignore.file.markdownDescription: Comment text that makes the formatter skip a whole document (CFG-03).

fuxiFmt.ignore.start.markdownDescription: Comment text that opens a range the formatter leaves alone (CFG-03).

fuxiFmt.ignore.end.markdownDescription: Comment text that closes such a range (CFG-03).

fuxiFmt.ignore.line.markdownDescription: Comment text that makes the formatter skip the next block (CFG-03).
